description: Expand a playlist, channel, podcast feed or page into its videos (a single video URL returns itself). A video URL that also names a playlist (watch?v=...&list=...) returns the video plus `list`, the playlist; pass playlist: true to expand the playlist instead. Use it to see what a list contains before reading, or pass the list straight to add_to_collection. Cost: about 40 tokens per item; limit defaults to 50.

playlist.description: When url is a video link that also names a playlist (list=), list the playlist instead of the one video

url.description: Playlist, channel, feed or page URL

name: list_items
title: List the videos in a playlist, channel or feed
